summary: Explains that a BGP speaker applying policy based on the RPKI should not send route refresh requests to neighbors just because it got new RPKI data. It describes how to avoid that by keeping a full Adj-RIB-In or saving paths dropped by route origin validation. It updates RFC 8481. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: When new rules arrive, a router should not ask everyone to resend everything. It should keep the rejected routes on a shelf so it can check them again.

questions: does rpki require bgp route refresh
how to reevaluate routes after rpki updates
